hero.tagline: The science behind India's crafts: each craft read as a cited monograph, each question answered with a source under every sentence, each fact contributed over MCP.
hero.label: KalaVigyan: the science behind India's crafts, each craft read as a cited monograph, each question answered with a source under every sentence, each fact contributed over MCP

cards.label: What KalaVigyan does: crafts as cited monographs, answers with every sentence cited, the atlas and its map layers, a studio for contributors' AI over MCP, lessons and voice, and open data with a DOI

items.title: Every craft a monograph
items.body: Each craft reads as one cited document: process, chemistry, place, people and pictures, built from stored facts.

items.title: Every sentence cited
items.body: Ask in any of 13 languages; each sentence links to the quoted passage it rests on, or it is not shown.

items.title: The atlas and its maps
items.body: Every craft's districts on the Survey of India outline, with relief, rivers and mineral layers.

items.title: A studio for your AI
items.body: Contributors' agents search, read and quote sources, then propose facts, structure, components and pages.

items.title: Lessons and voice
items.body: Professors make lesson packs and files from explainers, and a finished explainer can be read aloud.

items.title: Open data with a DOI
items.body: A reproducible release of facts, sources, crafts and structure, deposited on Zenodo under CC BY 4.0.

cards:mcp.label: The MCP studio in six groups: reading, sources, work, proposing, pages and pictures

items.title: Read what is known
items.body: Find crafts, read a page's fields, facts and components, and ask KalaVigyan a cited question.

items.title: Search and read sources
items.body: The registries, reader and quote matcher the gates use, and sources only the contributor can open.

items.title: Take open work
items.body: List open work, reserve tasks, steward a craft and follow every proposal made.

items.title: Propose what a page needs
items.body: Up to 25 quoted facts at a time, a page's structure and new sources, each passed through the gates.

items.title: Build and preview a page
items.body: Edit a draft, preview it against the page checklist, then propose the finished page.

items.title: Give pictures
items.body: Pictures from a link, a file or an upload, each screened before review.
